# succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase (SSADH) deficiency (*ALDH5A1*) corpus search log

*Generated by `analysis/corpus/corpus_summary.py` from this folder's files on 2026-10-20. Re-running the scripts reproduces the numbers, subject to database changes since the search date.*

## PubMed query

```
("succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency"[tiab] OR "SSADH deficiency"[tiab] OR SSADHD[tiab] OR "4-hydroxybutyric aciduria"[tiab] OR "gamma-hydroxybutyric aciduria"[tiab] OR "4-hydroxybutyricaciduria"[tiab] OR ALDH5A1[tiab] OR ALDH5A1[Gene Name]) AND ("case reports"[pt] OR "case report"[tiab] OR patient*[tiab] OR cohort[tiab] OR family[tiab] OR families[tiab])
```

- **Dates:** database inception to the search date (pre-registration §5.1).
- **Hits:** 254.

## Seeds

| File | Rows |
|---|---|

- `background_bibliography.csv`: this disease's entries in `background/manifest.csv`, minus comparator holdouts (`disease_seeds.py background`).

**Manifest:** 357 records.

## Screening (title and abstract)

- **Route:** Claude Code helper agents (Sonnet), batches of up to 100 records, each with its own scratch directory, following `pipeline/extract/claude_code/prompts/screen_v2.md` with this disease's block from `configs/diseases.yaml`. Prompt hash in `screening/screening_log.json`.
- **Relevance:** no 165, unclear 46, yes 146.
- **In the extraction corpus:** 171 (relevance yes or unclear; case report, case series/cohort or review).
  - by relevance: unclear 34, yes 137;
  - by study type: case report 80, case series/cohort 66, review/meta-analysis 25.
- **Human check:** not yet done. `screening/study_type_spotcheck.csv` holds 20 rows (seed 20261018) for it; pre-registration §5.1 asks for a random 10% of inclusions.
- **Full-text screening:** not yet done. It will remove some papers, especially "unclear" ones.

## Full text

- **Fetched:** 59 of 171 corpus papers (34.5%) as JATS XML from Europe PMC or PMC (`fetch_fulltext.py`). Access status in the corpus: paywalled 106, europepmc_xml 29, pmc_efetch_xml 23, publisher_pdf 7, not_found 6.
- **"Paywalled" here means no PMC copy.** Unpaywall was skipped because `UNPAYWALL_EMAIL` is unset. Of the papers without full text, 21 more list a free or open copy outside PMC in Europe PMC (`oa_elsewhere.json`); with them, at most 80 of 171 (46.8%). Not fetched.
- **Relevance yes, primary papers** (case reports and series): 135; with full text 45 (33.3%).
- **D-08 (decided: at least 15 eligible primary reports with accessible full text):** provisionally met (45 relevance-"yes" primary papers with full text; full-text screening will decide).
